;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram]] fighters loyal to ISIS attacked a [[Military|military]] base in the Nigerian town of Metele, killing at least 118 soldiers while at least 153 others were missing after the attack, the militants also seized tanks, armored vehicles, artillery, weapons, and ammunition [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-insurgency/militants-kill-around-100-nigerian-soldiers-in-attack-on-army-base-sources-idUSKCN1NR1SR (Reuters)]

**The number of structures destroyed in the [[Woolsey Fire]] rises to 1,452. [http://www.latimes.com/local/california/la-me-california-fires-woolsey-hill-camp-california-fires-structures-destroyed-1542596522-htmlstory.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]

;International relations
*[[APEC Papua New Guinea 2018]]
**The [[Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation|APEC]] summit in [[Papua New Guinea]] ends without a [[communiqué]] for the first time in the forum's history. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-apec-summit-energy/apec-fails-to-reach-consensus-as-u-s-china-divide-deepens-idUSKCN1NN00M (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Myanmar]] [[Myanmar Police Force|police]] fire warning shots at a crowd of [[Rohingya people|Rohingya Muslims]] after arresting two [[human smuggler]]s at a camp for [[Forced displacement|displaced persons]] near [[Sittwe]], [[Rakhine State]]. Four people are injured directly by the gunfire, prompting the [[United Nations|U.N.]] Resident and Humanitarian Coordinator to call for "calm and restraint". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya/myanmar-police-shoot-injure-four-in-raid-on-rohingya-camp-witness-idUSKCN1NN0AD (Reuters)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/shots-fired-at-rohingya-camp/4664474.html (VOA News)]

;Politics and elections
*A planned [[transgender rights]] rally in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], is attacked by far-right radicals. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/ukraine-transgender-lgbt-far-righ-1.4910844 (CBC News)]
*[[Central American migrant caravans]]
**Hundreds of residents take to the streets in the [[Mexico|Mexican]] city [[Tijuana]], in protest of the arrival of thousands of migrants trying to get to the [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46256878 (BBC)]
